This is a slight change in the namespace cgroup subsystem api.
The change is that previously when cgroup_clone() was called (currently
only from the unshare path in ns_proxy cgroup
column2: you'd get a new group named

column1: node_$pid"" whereas now you'll get a group named after just your pid.)
The only users who would notice it are those who are using the ns_proxy
cgroup subsystem to auto-create cgroups when namespaces are unshared -
something of an experimental feature
column2: which I think really needs more

column1: complete container/namespace support in order to be useful.  I suspect the
only users are Cedric and Serge
column2: or maybe a few others on

column1: containers@lists.linux-foundation.org.  And in fact it would only be
noticed by the users who make the assumption about how the name is
generated
column2: rather than getting it from the /proc/<pid>/cgroups file for

column1: the process in question.
Whether the change is actually needed or not I'm fairly agnostic on
guess it is more elegant to just use the pid as the new group name rather
than adding a fairly arbitrary ""node_"" prefix on the front.
